thread:
mia (ux): sharing a compact prototype for the latency page - main ideas: fold heatmap into a mini-sparkline on narrow viewports, add a "simulate sampling" modal, and surface p95 CI bands. mock: https://img.redwood.internal/tmp/compact-heatmap.png :eyes:

carter (product): Love the simulate modal. asks: default presets should stay Last 1h/24h/7d and add a custom quick-toggle. Also can baseline persist across reloads? PMs will want that pinned.

lin (eng): Persistence is fine. Implementation note: heatmap folding should request coarser tiles server-side to avoid overfetching. For simulate, we'll reuse cached aggregates and run a cheap approximate replay. Cache per-org for 12h.

anya (a11y): A11y notes: each heatmap cell must be keyboard-focusable with aria-label "HH:MM - p95 Xms, N reqs". Color-only intensity is problematic; add numeric overlay or pattern option. Ensure contrast ratios meet 4.5:1.

mia (ux): Will add a pattern toggle in view settings and enlarge hit targets to 44px. The simulate modal will show a 4-row table: sample %, est p95, est detection power, and cost estimate.

carter (product): Product nit: Call the slider "Sampling for visualizations" and add a tooltip: "Lower sampling reduces cost but may underrepresent rare spikes." Also default sampling = 100% for new users.

lin (eng): Default 100% is OK. Also: debounce scrubber drags client-side (150ms) and only fetch immediately on snap/mouseup to avoid backend spam. We'll add feature flag heatmap-folding=false by default.

anya (a11y): Simulate results must be presented in plain text (no reliance on color) and the modal should announce progress updates to screen readers. Keyboard shortcuts: arrow keys for micro-navigation in heatmap, Home/End to jump edges.

mia (ux): Good. I'll wire up micro-copy: "Detection power" for the probability of spotting spikes at that sampling. I'll include a low-sample warning pill when <20%: "Low sampling may miss rare latency spikes".

carter (product): Telemetry: track when users run simulate, accept suggested sampling, and pin baseline. Also surface a one-click "apply recommended" from simulate.

lin (eng): For simulate cost: estimate tokens scanned and show rough cost. We'll cap simulate to the last 7d by default and require confirmation for longer ranges.

ui-bot: Task created: UX updates, backend simulate caching, heatmap a11y audit, telemetry events.

mia (ux): Next steps: update prototype with CI band, simulate modal table, pattern overlay toggle, and shareable URL params for {range, baselinePinned, sampling}. Posting updated link in ~2h. (reacts :rocket:)
